<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Jio Platforms IPO:</strong> SEBI has issued an observation letter for the ₹37,000 crore Jio Platforms IPO, which is set to become the largest public issue in Indian market history.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE5wN1NOY0I1cFdkcGl0bHkxVjhHeXJkT2hYckN2RTdvV2VNV0VfeDNjbGxwdGhSSUh0Yk51SWJuU1Q1a21HcmJXeVJfQ2Zfb1VGdk5peUR3dTRVbjEzNl9rRFZ6bFJSSFJtNzU0cWM5QQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTFB5MW55V0p3Rmdic0JSTnhIbjAwUTY4dmNlV2dYXzhaQ2JrVE1vSndLNXJibGdGVEpvUGIzcllacEdaeFNwbklQTWZrWFRvTDJBbUJRVzNkLXB4ajVacWp4RkoyeDNGaDNjOWc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Updates:</strong> SEBI has approved a broad set of new regulatory norms covering market intermediaries, foreign investors, alternative investment funds, and corporate governance, while also proposing a new advertisement code for online bond platforms.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Forex Reserves:</strong> India’s foreign exchange reserves have reached an all-time high of $729.3 billion, bolstered by recent RBI interventions aimed at attracting US dollar inflows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> Indian benchmark indices recorded their third consecutive weekly decline, marking the longest losing streak in five months despite a brief mid-week rebound driven by IT stocks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
